subject: evidence preservation
scenario: Restarting the affected pods would probably restore service and would destroy the in-memory state the investigation depends on. Evidence collected after remediation is not evidence.
expected_behaviors: WF-INCIDENT collects and seals evidence before MITIGATE.
MITIGATE cannot complete without sealed evidence.
The evidence artifact is immutable after creation.
failure_conditions: Mitigation proceeds with no evidence record.
The evidence record can be rewritten afterwards.
